entities.name: Query CoaBC
observations: 402-aa bifunctional CoA-biosynthesis enzyme inferred from sequence homology.
Contains an N-terminal Flavoprotein domain (PF02441, residues 2-176) and a C-terminal DFP domain (PF04127, residues 185-396).
Best curated homologs are Haemophilus influenzae CoaBC P44953 and Bacillus subtilis CoaBC O35033, with 42.3% and 40.4% identity and near-complete coverage.
Expected to bind FMN and require Mg2+ based on curated CoaBC homolog annotations.

entities.name: CoaBC
observations: Bifunctional coenzyme A biosynthesis protein catalyzing phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activities.
Curated homologs P44953 and O35033 are annotated with EC 6.3.2.5 and EC 4.1.1.36.
Curated homologs bind one FMN per subunit and use Mg2+.

entities.name: CoA ligase step
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP -> N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+.
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:19397 and EC 6.3.2.5 in curated CoaBC homologs.

entities.name: CoA decarboxylation step
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:16793 and EC 4.1.1.36 in curated CoaBC homologs.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC performs sequential steps 2 and 3 of CoA biosynthesis from (R)-pantothenate.
